witnesses.label: Transform round-trip precision: float64 vs float32 storage of coordinates/sampling/origin

executed.stdout:

float32: phys=[249787.109375, -179893.609375, 12024.400390625]
float32: max voxel error after round-trip = 0.0252686 voxels (rel 1.23e-05)
threshold: float64 must stay < 1e-9 voxels; float32 shown for contrast

witnesses.input: 90-degree rotation about z; sampling (0.104, 0.104, 0.400) um/voxel; stage translation (250000, -180000, 12000) um; probe voxel (1023, 2047, 61); float32 emulated via struct.pack('f').
witnesses.justified_expected: A 3x3 rotation with unit determinant is exactly invertible in exact arithmetic; float64 should keep round-trip error near machine epsilon scaled by matrix condition (< 1e-9 voxels); float32's ~1e-7 relative epsilon on ~2.5e5 um magnitudes should leave visible sub-pixel error.
witnesses.observed: float64 max error 7.16e-11 voxels (rel 3.5e-14) - PASS; float32 max error 0.0253 voxels (rel 1.23e-5) - two orders above the float64 threshold.
witnesses.scope_limits: Pure arithmetic model of a 3-axis affine; no rendering, no real instrument data, no GPU path. Supports the storage rule (float64), not a measurement of any shipped viewer.

witnesses.label: Rank-map after dimension reduction (napari #5004 mechanism) + annotation JSON round-trip stability

executed.stdout:
order        single-argsort   double-argsort (identity-preserving)
(0, 1)       (0, 1)           (0, 1)
(1, 0)       (1, 0)           (1, 0)
(2, 1, 0)    (2, 1, 0)        (2, 1, 0)
(2, 0, 1)    (1, 2, 0)        (2, 0, 1)
(4, 0, 2)    (1, 2, 0)        (2, 0, 1)
json round-trip exact float coordinates: True
canonical sha256 stable: True 33f43898f2dc2862

witnesses.input: Orders (0,1), (1,0), (2,1,0), (2,0,1), (4,0,2) through both the pre-fix single-argsort and post-fix double-argsort rank maps (algorithms transcribed from captured napari diff S5); a sample annotation document with float64 physical coordinates serialized with sort_keys and re-parsed.
witnesses.justified_expected: Single argsort is a different (wrong) permutation for non-monotonic orders; double argsort equals argsort(argsort(x)) which is the identity-preserving rank map. JSON round-trip of float64 via json.dumps/loads is exact (IEEE754 shortest-repr), so canonical hashing must be stable.
witnesses.observed: Single-argsort diverges exactly on non-monotonic orders ((2,0,1)->(1,2,0), (4,0,2)->(1,2,0)); double-argsort matches the S5 docstring examples ((2,0,1)->(2,0,1), (4,0,2)->(2,0,1)); JSON coordinates exact; canonical sha256 stable.
witnesses.scope_limits: Verifies the arithmetic pattern published in napari's public diff (S5) and JSON/stdlib behavior; it does not import napari and does not test our application. Supports adopting permutation-parametrized coordinate tests, not any claim about napari releases beyond S2/S5.

witnesses.label: Crash-safety of atomic save protocol (temp + fsync + os.replace; recovery scan)
witnesses.plan: Run the save path in a harness; SIGKILL the process at randomized offsets during project.json and annotations writes on ext4 and on an SMB-mounted NTFS volume; reopen: previous generation must load; stale .tmp files must be cleaned; uncommitted provenance op must be discarded; repeat 100 times per filesystem.
witnesses.justified_expected: Per POSIX rename semantics on the same filesystem, readers see either old or new file content; directory fsync makes the rename durable. SMB servers may weaken ordering, hence the explicit test.
witnesses.scope_limits: UNEXECUTED. Requires real filesystems and process-kill harness; not runnable in the admitted sandbox.

witnesses.label: 3 GB real-file bounded-memory run (OME-TIFF and OME-Zarr)
witnesses.plan: On the target 8-core/16 GB workstation class, page slices of a real >=3 GB OME-TIFF and OME-Zarr through the bounded accessor; sample peak RSS every 200 ms; assert peak < 4 GB; measure cancel latency (must be <= one chunk decode); measure p95 slice latency while randomly seeking.
witnesses.justified_expected: Chunk/tile-addressable access (S1 section 2.1; S12 tile/zarr examples) should keep RSS governed by cache budget (512 MiB) + working set, independent of file size.
witnesses.scope_limits: UNEXECUTED. Needs real multi-GB files and a desktop OS environment; W2's arithmetic is the current (weaker) evidence.

witnesses.label: Cross-machine reopen with path relocation
witnesses.plan: Create project + annotations on machine A (Linux/ext4), copy project (without images) to machine B (Windows/NTFS) where images live at different paths; run relink via size+sha256 matching; assert annotation physical coordinates bit-identical and axis tables unchanged.
witnesses.justified_expected: Coordinates are stored as float64 physical values independent of paths; identity verification uses content hashes, so relocation must not alter any stored coordinate.
witnesses.scope_limits: UNEXECUTED. Needs two machines/OSes and the implemented import/export stack.

witnesses.label: Export fidelity round-trip (table + GeoJSON + overlay + derived image)

witnesses.justified_expected: Exports carry full coordinate-space metadata in-band (Sections 10, S6, S9), so a faithful reimplementation must reproduce coordinates within float64 tolerance.
